content: इडा, -ला [इल्-अच्, वा लस्य डत्वम्] .²1 The earth; प्रवुध्यते नूनमिडातलस्थः <ls>Mb.</ls> .²2 Speech. .²3 An offering, libation (coming between प्रयाज and अनुयाज); अग्निश्च ते योनिरिडा च देहः <ls>Mb. 3. 114. 28</ls>. .²4 Refreshing draught. .²5 (Hence) Food. .²6 (<ab>Fig.</ab>) Stream or flow of praise or worship personified as the goddess of sacred speech; इडोपहूताः कोशन्ति कुञ्जरास्त्वङ्कुशरिताः <ls>Mb. 12. 98. 26</ls>. .²7 Libation and offering of milk. .²8 A cow. इडेरन्ते <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 3. 49</ls>. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of a goddess, daughter of Manu. (She is the wife of Budha and mother of Purūravas; she is also called मैत्रावरुणी as the daughter of मित्र and वरुण). .²10 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā .²11 Heaven. .²12 A tubular vessel (नाडीभेद), (being in the right side of the body).
